content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Des Moines

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your academic background, then gather evidence of your hands-on project leadership. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify you meet the credential's prerequisites before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, learning directly from active certified practitioners. This formal education covers the full PMBOK® Guide framework and equips you with the knowledge needed to pass the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35 contact hours, create your PMI account and submit your formal application with proof of education and experience. Pay the required PMI exam fee to activate your eligibility window. Our team guides you through every field to ensure accuracy and fast approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam at a testing center convenient to you in the Des Moines area. Pass the PMP exam to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Every three years, renew your PMP by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or publication. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current with project-management best practices and standards.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
